name: scott-claude-plugins
description: Personal plugins for Claude. Each plugin's description states which surface it needs: Cowork, Claude Code, or both.

plugins.name: cowork-project-scaffold
plugins.description: Cowork only. Scaffolds a git-backed Cowork Project folder whose documents state what is true while git holds the history, and generates a per-project document-maintenance skill to keep it that way.

plugins.name: prose-tuning
plugins.description: Learns a project's house prose style from edits already made, records it as prose-style.md with stable rule ids, and conforms the rest of the documents to it.
